The '''Leria Kerlsil system''' was a two-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] that contained the planet of [[Leria Kerlsil]]. It was located between the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]].<ref name="CTD" />
